sentences.text: Author: Joymalya Bagchi Bench: Joymalya Bagchi Sl. March 1, C.R.R. 3845 of 2016 45. 2017 Mr. Rajdeep Majumder, Mr. Moyukh Mukherjee, Ms. Shyanti Poddar, ...for the petitioner.
Mr. Pawan Kumar Gupta, ...for the State.
Let this revisional application appear along with C.R.R. 823 of 2015 under the same heading four weeks hence.

There will be stay of all further proceeding in General Register Case No. 3295 of 2016 arising out of Bhaktinagar Police Station Case No. 1299 of 2016 dated August 27, 2016 under Sections 272/420 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Darjeeling for a period of six weeks from date or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
